best_hook.why: A blood-streaked, mud-caked hand uncurling among thorns to reveal an emerald ring is an intriguing opening image.

best_cliffhanger.why: His scarred fist clenches beside the bucket of bloody water: vengeance is promised but not yet taken.

must_promos.why: Bloody hand holds up the ring, 'Now release my husband', the cuffs fall away, he cradles her shredded palms, and it cuts on 'What have they done to you?'
Tender bandaging by the fire builds to his dark vow that no one will hurt her again and a clenched fist of coming revenge.

standalone_risk: There is no antagonist on screen, so a stranger does not see who hurt her, why the ring mattered, or who the vengeance is aimed at.
notes: Quiet aftermath and romance beat; mainly useful as a revenge-setup tease.
